checks.name: identity
checks.observation: Viewed original and decoded runtime: one adult seated against a near-upright bench backrest with two dumbbells raised separately over the shoulders. The shoulder-press pose is recognizable.

checks.name: style-consistency
checks.observation: Compared with the previously inspected unchanged approved front-plank master: same muted blue-gray top, terracotta leggings, hair bun, natural adult proportions and restrained shaded educational finish; gray shoes and unbranded equipment.

checks.name: pose-and-grip-readability
checks.observation: Each hand visibly wraps a separate short dumbbell handle between its two solid ends. Arms, elbows, wrists, hands, both full legs and shoes are continuous. Hips sit on the seat, back is supported and feet read as planted below the knees. No obvious extra limb, floating weight, disconnected hand or extreme torso arch observed.

checks.name: equipment-continuity
checks.observation: Exactly two matching plain hex-ended dumbbells remain separated and complete. Padded seat/backrest, angled metal supports and front/rear bench feet read as coherent connected equipment. No visibly disconnected bench joint observed; engineering correctness is not certified.

checks.name: alpha-and-decoded-edges
checks.observation: Viewed source/export light and dark composites, decoded checkerboard and both sizes across all eight current container colors. Transparent surroundings and bench openings are clean; no distracting colored fringe, matte block or clipped extremity observed.

checks.name: small-usage-and-containment
checks.observation: Viewed actual source/runtime 256x144 and 320x180 helper panels and both-size all-eight composites. Raised paired weights, hand grips, seated support and full feet remain recognizable. Full weights, head, shoes and bench are contained. Visible alpha>=128 starts y25 and ends y911 of941, leaving about4.8dp above and5.7dp below at180 height: modest vertical room rather than ample margins.
